def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    closing_prices = [205, 210, 215, 220, 222, 225, 230, 235, 236, 240]
    period = 5

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    last_five_prices = closing_prices[-period:]
    moving_average = sum(last_five_prices) / period
    answer = round(moving_average, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
